conceptTest: Numerical modelling, probability and Bayesian inference, programming, imaging, Fourier methods and measurement are sustained elements of the degree or optional instrumentation minor. UCR applies related methods across a substantial mathematics, computing, imaging and signal sequence and applies observations to Earth. The programme does not cover astronomical objects, the major’s physics sequence, or direct telescope work.

candidateTests.astrophysics: Tested the physics and modelling palette, including both Sustainability Essentials, Dynamic Earth, Earth System Science Tools and the maths and signal sequence. UCR covers wave experiments, thermodynamics and mechanical principles in sustainability contexts, seismology and numerical tools. It lacks a sustained physical science sequence and stellar, galactic, cosmological or planetary systems study. Combining general modelling and geology would repeat the supported option without meeting the disciplinary direction.
candidateTests.radio astronomy: Tested Earth Observation, Image Processing, Linear Systems, both sustainability gateways, networks, robotics and computational control. Fourier analysis, interference, spectroscopy and sensing contribute related methods, but this palette does not provide radio telescopes, antennas and receivers, calibration, radio interferometry or astronomy observations. A computing variant would give greater weight to methods already represented. No second coherent target-responsive concept cleared the substance gate, so the numerical pairwise floor is not applicable.
candidateTests.unselected adjacent courses: Advanced Algorithms supports numerical and Fourier computation but competes in the fourth term with numerical methods, signals, robotics and Earth Observation. Software Development offers C++ and Haskell and disciplined development, but is less direct than the selected modelling and sensing work. Energy & Sustainability studies generation, storage and grid integration, whereas Dynamic Earth gives remote sensing a more direct observational application. Earth System Science Tools offers modelling, proxies and tracers for Earth systems, but the selected geology and Earth Observation form a clearer progression within available places. AI Ethics and Reinforcement Learning offer useful perspectives but waves and field-based evidence give stronger contributions to this concept.

ENSGATE101.name: Sustainability Essentials I

ENSGATE201.name: Sustainability Essentials II

alignment.rationale: Both use single-variable differentiation and integration, Taylor expansions and elementary differential equations. Groningen emphasises physical applications.
Both develop matrices, systems of equations, vector spaces, linear maps and eigenvalues.
Both implement interpolation, numerical integration, root finding and numerical solutions to differential equations. Groningen uses Python for methods common in astronomical research.
Both extend calculus to several variables. Groningen specifically develops vector fields and integral theorems used in physics.
Both use differential equations and Fourier analysis to study systems. Groningen also introduces partial differential equations in physics. UCR concentrates on signals, filters and feedback.
Both develop probability, Bayesian inference and hypothesis testing. Groningen applies statistics and error analysis to astronomical data.
Both introduce programming for computational problems. Groningen uses the course as preparation for Observational Astronomy.

Both work with acquired observations, spectral information and data processing. UCR focuses on Earth remote sensing and mapping. Groningen uses telescopes, photometry and spectroscopy in an astronomical observing project.
Both investigate wave behaviour and interference through practical work. Groningen gives dedicated treatment to electromagnetic waves, optics and the mathematical description of these phenomena.

academicConstruction: Image Processing moves to 2027h1. Added wave experiments through Sustainability Essentials II and geological measurement through Dynamic Earth, replacing AI Ethics and Reinforcement Learning. Moved Machine Learning before advanced data work and rescheduled Networks and Database Management Systems. Retains six advanced courses and early PPD. The bounded wave correspondence adds one defensible alignment; unmatched specialist components stay separate.
